items.name: [Concept] Double exposure / environment inside the silhouette
items.description:
THE MODEL IS BASED ON THE WORKS OF THIS AUTHOR


The model is quite tricky to use and I can only make a couple of recommendations:

  1. It works best at 896:1344 , 832:1344 and similar resolutions.

  2. Simplify the prompt as much as possible! Remove everything related to character's colors (green eyes, brown hair, etc.)
    You can also use tags like “red theme, green theme, blue theme”

  3. Character models based on Illustrious work with this concept, I recommend lowering their weight to 0.6-0.7

  4. Clothing elements can be specified and it will work, but I recommend to add 2-3 tags related to clothing

  5. The appearance of small silhouettes of people is inevitable because the model is created on the works of one particular author (I could remove them in photoshop before training, but it would take an extremely long time and I'm too lazy for that). That is why the “main silhouette” is always human

You can suggest me characters whose model you want to see! (just pm me)

items.name: Double Exposure •••FLUX••• @Ethanar
items.description:
Theme

The Double Exposure LoRA is designed to recreate the striking visual effect of double exposure photography, where two images are superimposed to create a single, cohesive composition. This LoRA captures the dreamy, surreal qualities of this technique, blending multiple elements into a unified, evocative piece of art.

Key Features

Layered Imagery:

Emphasizes the seamless blending of two distinct images, allowing elements from each to merge harmoniously. This can include combining portraits with landscapes, urban scenes with nature, or any other combination that tells a story or evokes a specific mood.

Transparency and Overlap:

Supports varying levels of transparency, where one image fades into another, creating smooth transitions between the two layers. This effect can be used to highlight specific details or to create a sense of movement and depth within the artwork. Adding "white background" works as an addition to that. 😊

Contrast and Composition:

Enhances the contrast between light and dark areas, which is crucial for making both images in the double exposure stand out while maintaining a balanced composition. This ensures that the final image is both visually appealing and conceptually strong.

Application:

Perfect for creating conceptual art, surreal photography, and promotional materials that require a creative and artistic touch. This LoRA can also be used in music album covers, posters, and other designs where a powerful, dual-layered visual narrative is desired.

Visual Impact:

The double exposure effect adds a layer of complexity and depth, making the final image more engaging and thought-provoking. It’s ideal for projects that aim to convey abstract ideas, emotional states, or to visually represent a blend of concepts or themes.

Target Audience:

Ideal for photographers, digital artists, and graphic designers who want to experiment with the creative possibilities of double exposure. This LoRA is particularly useful for those looking to produce art that is both visually stunning and conceptually rich, making it suitable for both personal projects and commercial work.

Usage:

Apply this LoRA to create compelling double exposure effects that merge multiple images into a single, cohesive artwork. Whether you’re working on portraits, landscapes, or abstract designs, this LoRA will help you achieve the intricate and evocative style that double exposure is known for.
